All other matters presented at the Meeting received over 96% approval from the shareholders at the meeting, including the proposed appointment of Baker Tilly WM LLP, Chartered Professional Accountants, as auditors of Starcore and the proposed Stock Option Plan, the full version of which can be viewed on the Company's website at

Subsequent to the Meeting, the Board of Directors appointed Robert Eadie as President and Chief Executive Officer, Salvador Garcia as Chief Operating Officer, Gary Arca as Chief Financial Officer and Cory Kent as Corporate Secretary.

Starcore International Mines is engaged in precious metals production with focus and experience in Mexico. The Company's base of producing assets includes its gold producing San Martin Mine and the permitted La Tortilla silver project, both in the state of Queretaro, Mexico. The Company is a leader in Corporate Social Responsibility and advocates value driven decisions that will increase long term shareholder value.
